user.title: Protect a gateway
user.description: Set the gateway IP and intended root password. This does not change the gateway password. After installing the startup hook, restart Home Assistant BEFORE setting the gateway password.

data_description.password: Use the same password later in the gateway script. Stored by HA as private config entry data.
data_description.install_bootstrap: Adds a marked block to custom_components/__init__.py and retains its existing code. XiaomiGateway3 files are not changed.

error.invalid_password: Enter a nonempty single-line password, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.
error.bootstrap_required: Install the startup hook to guarantee deletion blocking before XiaomiGateway3 starts.
error.bootstrap_failed: Cannot safely write the startup hook. Check custom_components permissions and existing initializer syntax.
error.already_configured: This gateway already has a patch entry.

create_entry.default: Restart Home Assistant to activate the early hook before setting the gateway root password. An initial retry/restart-required status is expected.

init.title: Gateway password settings
init.description: Changing these settings does not change the password on the gateway. Leave the password blank to keep it.

data_description.password: Blank keeps the existing password; the saved password is never shown.

error.invalid_password: Enter a valid single-line password, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.
error.already_configured: Another patch entry already uses this IP.

restart_required.title: Restart Home Assistant to activate the gateway password patch
restart_required.description: The early startup hook is installed. Restart Home Assistant before changing the gateway root password. No XiaomiGateway3 source file or gateway password was changed.
